task: add a field through the site and show it
note: hand-authored model replies, not recorded from a model (see ../README.md)

text: Add a Nickname field to user accounts and show it on this form after Full Name.

arguments.summary: Add a Nickname field to user accounts and show it after Full Name

files.text:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<screen-extend xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xsi:noNamespaceSchemaLocation="http://moqui.org/xsd/xml-screen-3.xsd">
    <form-single name="UserAccountForm">
        <field name="nickname" after="userFullName"><default-field title="Nickname"><text-line size="30"/></default-field></field>
    </form-single>
</screen-extend>

text: The Nickname field is added: an extend-entity of UserAccount in the example (site) component's entity file, and the user account form shows Nickname after Full Name through a screen-extend. Restart the server to add the nickname column.
